name: Blue
maintainer: Robotic Decision Making Lab (Oregon State University)
description: ROS 2 framework to develop, test, and deploy autonomy on underwater vehicles. Supports the BlueROV2 through ArduSub and MAVROS, Gazebo simulation, and custom controllers from auv_controllers. The default Docker image and CI target ROS 2 Rolling; humble and jazzy branches exist.

name: Project11
maintainer: UNH Center for Coastal and Ocean Mapping (CCOM/JHC)
description: Community framework for marine robotics that started on hydrographic survey ASVs. The default branch targets ROS 2 Jazzy; Melodic and Noetic branches are legacy.

name: CAMP
description: CCOM Autonomous Mission Planner. Mission planning and monitoring operator interface that is part of Project11.

name: MVP (Marine Vehicle Packages)
description: Guidance and control framework for surface and underwater vehicles, with Stonefish simulation interfaces. Active ROS 2 development is on the jazzy-devel branches of mvp_control and mvp_mission.
note: The mvp_readme instructions describe the ROS Noetic release.

name: Orca4
description: ROS 2 AUV packages for a BlueROV2 running ArduSub. Uses mavros, Nav2 for missions, ORB_SLAM2 stereo visual odometry, and Gazebo Harmonic with the standard buoyancy, hydrodynamics, and thruster plugins.

name: Orca5
description: Successor to Orca4. Gives visual odometry to a BlueROV2 running ArduSub from ORB_SLAM3 and one down-facing camera, without Nav2 or mavros. Targets ROS 2 Jazzy and Gazebo Harmonic.

name: SMaRC 2
description: ROS 2 packages for the SMaRC vehicles (for example SAM and LoLo), with documentation, examples, and shared message definitions. Simulation runs in Unity (SMARCUnity). The default branch targets ROS 2 Humble; a jazzy branch is work in progress.

name: SUAVE
description: Self-adaptive underwater vehicle exemplar for pipeline inspection research. Uses ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Harmonic, and ArduSub, and has Docker images for headless experiment campaigns.

name: COLA2
description: Control architecture for the Girona 500 and Sparus II AUVs (navigation, control, and mission execution). The source is readable, but the license limits use to IQUA Robotics licensees.

name: MOOS-IvP
description: Behavior-based marine autonomy suite (MOOS middleware and the IvP Helm multi-objective behavior arbiter). Not ROS-based, but common on research and naval vehicles. There is no widely maintained public ROS 2 bridge; most teams write a small gateway.

name: DUNE
description: Unified Navigation Environment. Onboard software of the LSTS toolchain, which uses the IMC message protocol. Not ROS-based.

name: auv_controllers
maintainer: Robotic Decision Making Lab (Oregon State University)
description: ros2_control controllers for underwater vehicles, including twist, trajectory, impedance, and whole-body controllers, a thruster allocation matrix controller, and thruster controllers. Supports ROS 2 Rolling and Jazzy.

name: mvp_control
description: Optimization-based control allocation for multi-thruster vehicles, including articulated thrusters. ROS 2 on jazzy-devel, ROS 1 on noetic-devel.

name: mvp_mission
description: Behavior-based mission and guidance layer for MVP vehicles. ROS 2 on jazzy-devel.

name: thruster_manager
description: Maps a desired wrench to thruster forces. Reads the thruster layout from the URDF on robot_description; usable as a node, a component, or a C++ class (Eigen).

name: ros2_control
description: Standard ROS 2 framework for hardware interfaces and real-time controllers. Underwater controllers such as auv_controllers build on it.

name: ArduPilot (ArduSub, Rover)
description: Open-source autopilot. ArduSub runs on the BlueROV2 and many hobby ROVs; the Rover firmware supports boats. Connects to ROS through MAVLink (mavros) or the built-in DDS interface for ROS 2.

name: ardusub_driver
maintainer: Robotic Decision Making Lab (Oregon State University)
description: Packages that integrate ROS 2 with vehicles that run ArduSub, such as the BlueROV2. Supports ROS 2 Rolling and Jazzy.

name: mavros
description: MAVLink to ROS bridge for ArduPilot and PX4 vehicles. The default branch is ros2.

name: PX4 Autopilot
description: Open-source autopilot with boat support and ROS 2 integration through uXRCE-DDS. Check the PX4 documentation for the current status of underwater frames.

name: BlueOS
description: Onboard software platform for Blue Robotics vehicles (Raspberry Pi based). Manages ArduPilot firmware, video, and Docker-based extensions; ROS can run as an extension.

name: robot_localization
description: EKF and UKF state estimation for any number of odometry, twist, pose, and IMU inputs, plus navsat_transform_node to fuse GNSS fixes. The most common fusion node on ROS marine vehicles.

name: fuse
description: Plugin-based factor-graph state estimation framework (Ceres solver). Alternative to filter-based fusion when you need smoothing or custom constraints.

name: GTSAM
description: C++ and Python factor-graph library (iSAM2) used by many underwater SLAM systems, for example sonar-SLAM.

name: Nav2
description: ROS 2 navigation framework (planners, controllers, behavior trees, costmaps). Used for 2D navigation on surface vehicles and in some underwater stacks such as Orca4.

name: mesh_navigation
description: Path planning and navigation on 3D triangle meshes, an option for terrain and structures that a 2D costmap cannot represent.

name: geographic_info
description: geographic_msgs (GeoPoint, GeoPose, and more) and the geodesy package for UTM and WGS 84 conversions in ROS.

name: GeographicLib
description: Accurate geodesic, UTM/UPS, local Cartesian (ENU), and geoid conversions in C++ with bindings for other languages.

name: pyproj
description: Python interface to PROJ for coordinate reference system transforms. Useful in post-processing and mission planning tools.

name: sonar_image_proc
description: Processing and visualization for forward-looking imaging sonar data that uses marine_acoustic_msgs. The ros2 branch was tested with Blueprint Oculus M1200d and M750d sonars.

name: sonar-SLAM (BRUCE)
description: Graph-based pose SLAM for a BlueROV2 that fuses DVL and IMU dead reckoning with imaging sonar observations, using the iSAM2 backend.

name: SVIn
maintainer: Autonomous Field Robotics Lab (University of South Carolina)
description: Tightly coupled sonar-visual-inertial-depth SLAM for real-time underwater navigation, based on OKVIS with loop closing.

name: ORB-SLAM3
description: Visual and visual-inertial SLAM library (mono, stereo, RGB-D). Not marine-specific, but used underwater, for example in Orca5.

name: OpenVINS
description: Filter-based visual-inertial odometry with ROS 1 and ROS 2 support. A common baseline for underwater visual navigation research.

name: RTAB-Map ROS
description: Graph-based RGB-D, stereo, and lidar SLAM with ROS wrappers. Used for structure mapping on surface vehicles and in clear water.

name: image_pipeline
description: Camera calibration, rectification, and stereo processing. Calibrate underwater cameras in water, because the housing port changes the intrinsics.

name: MB-System
description: Open-source processing and display of swath bathymetry (multibeam) and sidescan sonar data. The standard post-processing toolkit in seafloor mapping.

name: VRX
description: Virtual RobotX surface vehicle simulation (WAM-V, waves, wind, competition tasks). The default branch runs Gazebo Harmonic with ROS 2 Jazzy; the humble branch keeps Gazebo Garden with ROS 2 Humble.

name: POSIM (DAVE for ROS 2)
description: The ROS 2 and Gazebo Sim migration of the DAVE underwater simulator, now named POSIM. Targets ROS 2 Lyrical on Ubuntu 26.04 and Gazebo Jetty, with Docker images. The earlier port is on the ros2 branch of IOES-Lab/dave.

name: DAVE (ROS 1, legacy)
description: Original DAVE underwater simulator on ROS 1 and Gazebo Classic, both now end of life. No commits since 2023; use POSIM for new work.

name: Stonefish
description: C++ library for marine robot simulation with hydrodynamics computed from geometry, plus sonar, DVL, camera, and manipulator models. Use it from ROS through stonefish_ros2.

name: stonefish_ros2
description: ROS 2 interface and standard simulator node for Stonefish. Loads scenarios from XML files; the package version must match the Stonefish library version.

name: HoloOcean
description: Underwater simulator on Unreal Engine 5.3 (since version 2.0) with a Python API and imaging sonar, DVL, and camera models. The engine source repository needs a GitHub account linked to Epic Games; the ROS 2 bridge is public.

name: holoocean-ros
description: Official ROS 2 bridge for HoloOcean, tested on Humble and Jazzy.

name: UNav-Sim
description: Underwater simulator built on Unreal Engine 5 and AirSim with ROS 1 and ROS 2 interfaces, aimed at visual navigation.

name: OceanSim
maintainer: University of Michigan Field Robotics Group
description: GPU-accelerated underwater perception simulation (camera, sonar, and DVL models) as an NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.0 extension. ROS 2 support is on the ROS2 branch through the Isaac Sim ROS 2 bridge.

name: MARUS 2
description: Marine robotics simulator in Unity 6 with a gRPC adapter to ROS 2 (marus2_ros_adapter). The original MARUS (Unity 2021.3, ROS 1 adapter) is in marus-core.

name: LRAUV simulation
description: Gazebo simulation of MBARI's Tethys-class Long-Range AUV that can run the real LRAUV controller binaries. Archived in 2025; its general-purpose plugins are upstreamed to gz-sim.

name: MBARI WEC
description: Gazebo simulation and ROS 2 interfaces for MBARI's wave energy converter buoy, with the same API for the physical and simulated buoy.

name: gz-sim maritime systems
description: Gazebo Sim ships the Buoyancy, Hydrodynamics, Thruster, LiftDrag, BuoyancyEngine, and DopplerVelocityLog systems that most current marine Gazebo projects use. There is no built-in wave system. Connect to ROS 2 through ros_gz.

name: ros_gz
description: Bridge and launch integration between ROS 2 and Gazebo Sim.

name: ardupilot_gazebo
description: Gazebo plugin that connects ArduPilot software-in-the-loop (for example ArduSub) to Gazebo Sim. Used by Orca4, Orca5, bluerov2_ignition, and SUAVE.

name: bluerov2_ignition
description: BlueROV2 base and heavy models for Gazebo Harmonic that use the standard buoyancy, hydrodynamics, and thruster systems. Proof-of-concept status per the README.

name: asv_wave_sim
description: Gazebo plugins for ocean wave fields and wave forces on surface vessels.

name: rs750
description: Racing Sparrow 750 sailboat model and wind simulation for Gazebo, with ArduPilot integration.

name: MBZIRC simulator
description: Simulation environment for the MBZIRC Maritime Grand Challenge (USV with UAVs) on Ignition Fortress and ROS 2 Galactic, both end of life. The challenge ended in 2024; use it for reference only.

name: TurtleBoat
description: Lightweight vessel dynamics simulator for learning ship control. Default branch is ros2.

name: ds_sim
description: Gazebo plugins and utilities (DVL, sensors, environment) from the WHOI Deep Submergence Lab. A GitHub mirror is at Field-Robotics-Lab/ds_sim.

name: Plankton
description: ROS 2 Foxy port of UUV Simulator for Gazebo Classic. Both are end of life, and there are no commits since 2021.

name: UUV Simulator
description: Historic Gazebo Classic underwater simulator, archived in 2023. Many current tools derive from its plugins.

name: unity-arduboat-sim
description: Unity simulation of an ArduRover boat for software-in-the-loop testing.

name: sbg_ros2_driver
description: Official ROS 2 driver for SBG Systems IMU, AHRS, and INS products (for example Ellipse).

name: microstrain_inertial
description: Official ROS and ROS 2 driver for MicroStrain inertial sensors (3DM-GX5, CV7, GQ7, and others). The default branch is ros2.

name: Xsens MTi ROS driver
description: ROS 1 and ROS 2 drivers for Xsens MTi sensors, built on the Xsens Device API, with an NTRIP client for RTK corrections. The ros2 branch supports Foxy, Humble, and Jazzy.

name: vectornav
description: Community driver for VectorNav VN-100, VN-200, and VN-300; ROS 2 on the ros2 branch. No official VectorNav ROS 2 driver was found.

name: Advanced Navigation ROS 2 driver
description: Example ROS 2 driver from Advanced Navigation for its INS products, tested on Ubuntu 22.04 and ROS 2 Humble.

name: waterlinked_dvl
maintainer: Water Linked (official, contributed by Oregon State RDML)
description: Official ROS 2 driver for the Water Linked DVL A50 and A125, with humble and jazzy branches.

name: Nortek Nucleus driver
description: Official Python driver for the Nortek Nucleus navigation sensor (DVL with AHRS and pressure), with ROS 2 packages and a BlueOS extension.

name: Water Linked DVL A50 driver (ROS 1)
description: Original ROS 1 driver for the Water Linked DVL A50. Archived; use waterlinked_dvl for ROS 2.

name: nmea_navsat_driver
description: Generic NMEA 0183 GNSS driver that publishes sensor_msgs/NavSatFix. ROS 2 on the ros2 branch.

name: ublox_dgnss
description: ROS 2 driver for u-blox ZED-F9P and related receivers over USB, with RTK support.

name: ublox
description: Long-standing u-blox GNSS driver; ROS 2 on the ros2 branch.

name: swiftnav-ros2
description: ROS 2 driver for Swift Navigation GNSS receivers (Piksi Multi, Duro).

name: ping360_sonar
description: Driver for the Blue Robotics Ping360 scanning imaging sonar (image and scan output). The default branch is ros2.

name: bluerobotics_ping360
description: ROS 2 Jazzy driver for the Ping360 with serial and UDP links, sector scanning, and point cloud output.

name: blueprint_oculus_sonar
description: ROS 2 Jazzy driver for Blueprint Subsea Oculus multibeam imaging sonars. Publishes polar and Cartesian images over UDP.

name: oculus_ros2
description: Community ROS 2 driver for Blueprint Subsea Oculus sonars, built on the oculus_driver library.

name: liboculus
description: C++ library for the Blueprint Subsea Oculus sonar network protocol, used by ROS drivers.

name: cerulean_surveyor_mbes
description: ROS 2 driver for the Cerulean Surveyor 240-16 multibeam echosounder (raw and XYZ ranges, serial or UDP).

name: blueos-ros2
description: Community BlueOS extension that runs ROS 2 Jazzy on Blue Robotics vehicles and bundles Ping1D, Ping360, and Sonoptix Echo drivers. Blue Robotics does not ship an official ROS 2 driver.

name: ping-python
description: Python library for Blue Robotics Ping-protocol devices (Ping2 echosounder, Ping360). Base for custom ROS nodes.

name: usb_cam
description: Driver for V4L2 USB cameras, common for low-cost ROV cameras.

name: ros2_v4l2_camera
description: ROS 2 driver for Video4Linux2 cameras.

name: gscam
description: GStreamer-based camera driver. Useful for the H.264 RTP/UDP video streams that ROV cameras and BlueOS publish.

name: ouster-ros
description: Official driver for Ouster lidars, often used on surface vehicles for docking and obstacle detection.

name: marine_ais
description: AIS message decoding and ROS messages for vessel traffic, used with Project11. The default branch is jazzy.

name: transport_drivers
description: Reusable serial and UDP driver nodes for ROS 2. A good base when you write a driver for a serial or Ethernet marine sensor.

name: marine_msgs
maintainer: UW APL, USF, NPS, UNH CCOM
description: Community message definitions. marine_acoustic_msgs has Dvl, RawSonarImage, ProjectedSonarImage, SonarDetections, and SonarRanges; marine_sensor_msgs has RadarSector, RadarEcho, and TurbidityNTU. Released as binaries from Noetic through Lyrical and Rolling.

name: maritime_interfaces
description: Placeholder for standard maritime interfaces. The main branch has no message definitions yet (proposals live on branches); use marine_msgs today.

name: ros_acomms
description: Transports ROS messages over acoustic links (WHOI Micro-Modem) and Iridium, with message packing, queue management, MAC, and a link simulator.
note: A merge request on the WHOI GitLab adds ROS 2 (Humble and Jazzy) support; check the documentation for its release status.

name: Goby3
description: Autonomy middleware designed for marine robots on slow and intermittent links (interthread, interprocess, and intervehicle publish-subscribe), with MOOS interoperability.

name: DCCL
description: Dynamic Compact Control Language. Encodes messages into very small payloads for acoustic modems and satellite links.

name: rmw_zenoh
description: ROS 2 middleware implementation on Zenoh. An option for robot-to-shore links over Wi-Fi, cellular, or radio where DDS discovery is a problem.

name: rosbridge_suite
description: JSON over WebSocket bridge for web dashboards and topside tools.

name: evologics_driver
description: Old ROS 1 driver for EvoLogics acoustic modems. No ROS 2 driver for EvoLogics modems was found.

name: imc_ros_bridge
description: Bridge between ROS and the LSTS IMC protocol, so ROS vehicles can be commanded from Neptus.

name: rosbag2
description: Record and replay ROS 2 data. MCAP is the default storage format in current ROS 2 releases.

name: MCAP
description: Open container format and libraries for timestamped multi-sensor logs (C++, Python, Go, Rust, and more).

name: rosbags
description: Pure Python library to read, write, and convert ROS 1 and ROS 2 bags without a ROS installation. Useful in data pipelines.

name: PlotJuggler
description: Time-series plotting for live topics and bag files. Fast for controller and EKF tuning.

name: RViz2
description: Standard 3D visualization for ROS 2 (TF, point clouds, markers, images).

name: Lichtblick
description: Open-source robotics visualization and log analysis app, forked from the last open-source Foxglove Studio release.

name: foxglove_bridge
description: WebSocket bridge that streams ROS topics to Foxglove and Lichtblick. Check the Foxglove SDK repository for newer development.

name: QGroundControl
description: Ground control station for MAVLink vehicles (ArduSub, ArduPilot Rover, PX4). Common as the topside pilot interface for the BlueROV2.

name: Neptus
description: Command, control, and mission review software of the LSTS toolchain (IMC protocol).

name: industrial_ci
description: Ready-made CI scripts that build and test ROS packages on GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other services.

name: action-ros-ci
description: GitHub Action that builds and tests a ROS 2 workspace with colcon.

name: awesome-maritime-robotics
description: The working group's earlier link list of open-source maritime robotics software. This catalog supersedes and extends it.

name: best-of-robot-simulators
description: Ranked, regularly updated list of robot simulators, including marine ones. Good for a wider survey.
